title: Speed Sensor Fault
shortDescription: ProForm treadmill console isn't receiving speed feedback.
fullDescription:
E1 on ProForm treadmills (Pro, Carbon, PerformancePro series) indicates the motor or roller speed sensor is not producing a signal. This is usually a simple harness or magnet alignment problem.

Power off, open the motor hood, and verify the speed sensor cable is firmly plugged into the motor controller. A misaligned magnet on the pulley is the next suspect.

fixSteps.title: Reseat sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove motor hood; reseat the two-pin speed sensor plug on the controller.

title: Incline Motor Error
shortDescription: Incline motor didn't respond to calibration or move request.
fullDescription:
E2 indicates the incline motor isn't responding correctly. Many ProForm consoles have a self-calibration routine — hold Stop + Speed buttons and insert key to trigger it.

If calibration fails, the incline motor itself is likely stuck or failed.

fixSteps.title: Calibrate incline
fixSteps.instruction: Remove safety key; hold Stop + Speed Up; insert key; follow calibration.

faq.a: Yes — check your model's manual for exact button combo.

title: Safety Key Missing
shortDescription: Magnetic safety key not seated in console.
fullDescription:
E3 or a similar key icon means the safety tether magnet is absent or its reed switch has failed. Check the key and holder.

If the key is present and E3 still appears, the reed switch in the console may need replacement.

fixSteps.title: Seat key
fixSteps.instruction: Press magnetic key fully into console holder.

faq.a: Yes — many generic magnetic keys work.

title: Drive Belt Slipping
shortDescription: Belt speed doesn't match commanded speed.
fullDescription:
E4 indicates the motor controller detected a mismatch between target and actual speed — often a slipping drive belt or overloaded running belt.

Lubricate the deck, check belt tension, and tighten front roller if belt slides side to side.

fixSteps.title: Lube deck
fixSteps.instruction: Apply 100% silicone lube under belt per manual.

whenToCallPro: Drive belt replacement if uncomfortable with pulley work.

title: Console Communication Lost
shortDescription: Console is not communicating with the motor controller.
fullDescription:
E5 points to a wiring or connector fault between console and controller. Pinched or kinked cable inside the upright after assembly is common.

Reseat cables at both ends and inspect for damage inside the frame upright.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cables
fixSteps.instruction: Lower console, disconnect and reconnect data cable.

faq.a: Unrelated — this is a wired link.

title: Motor Overload
shortDescription: Motor drew excessive current — controller shutdown.
fullDescription: E6 on ProForm is an overcurrent trip. Dry deck, heavy user, or a failing motor cause it. Lubricate and try again. Repeat E6 means professional motor service.

fixSteps.title: Lube deck
fixSteps.instruction: Apply silicone lube, test at lower speed.

title: Bike/Elliptical Resistance Motor Error
shortDescription: Magnetic resistance motor didn't respond to console command.
fullDescription:
E7 on ProForm bikes and ellipticals refers to the resistance motor actuator. When it doesn't move to commanded position, this code appears.

Check for binding, jammed brake pad, or a disconnected harness to the resistance motor.

fixSteps.title: Inspect resistance motor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove shroud; check resistance motor for binding or disconnect.

whenToCallPro: Resistance motor swap if you're not comfortable.

title: Heart Rate Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Console cannot read heart rate grips or chest strap.
fullDescription:
E8 on some ProForm models indicates a heart rate input fault. Normally heart rate issues are silent, but when paired with iFIT workouts requiring HR, a fault code may appear.

Check chest strap battery or grip contact cleanliness.

fixSteps.title: Clean grips
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe grip sensors with damp cloth, dry, grip with both hands firmly.

faq.a: ANT+ or Bluetooth Smart — check model.

title: iFIT Connection Lost
fullDescription:
When iFIT loses connection, workouts won't stream and some machines refuse to start iFIT-guided classes.

Check Wi-Fi, restart the console, and log back into iFIT.

faq.a: Most newer ProForms require it for full feature set.

title: Deck Lubrication Reminder
shortDescription: Treadmill reminds you to lubricate deck after set usage.
fullDescription: Not an error — LUB reminds you it's time to apply silicone lube. Follow the lubrication procedure, then reset the counter from engineering mode.

fixSteps.title: Lubricate
fixSteps.instruction: Lift belt at center, apply silicone under belt, walk at low speed to spread.

faq.a: 100% silicone — not WD-40 or generic lube.
